Let the centers be O1, O2 with distance d, radii r1, r2.

Internal tangent length squared: d² − (r1+r2)² = 361.
External tangent length squared: d² − (r1−r2)² = 1369.

Subtracting: 4r1r2 = 1008, so r1r2 = 252.

Expected value of XY²: with X, Y uniform on the circles, E[XY²] = d² + r1² + r2² (the cross terms average to zero).

So d² + r1² + r2² = 2023.

From the two tangent equations: adding gives 2d² − 2(r1²+r2²) = 1730, so d² − (r1²+r2²) = 865.

Adding this to d² + (r1²+r2²) = 2023 gives 2d² = 2888, so d² = 1444, d = 38.

Check: r1²+r2² = 579, and (r1+r2)² = 579+504 = 1083 = d² − 361 = 1083 ✓.

ANSWER: 38
